† रेव् रेव्, रेब् रेब्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go by leaps, to flow.
 2. To go.

रेवन्त्, i. e. रयि + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Wealthy,

= [] Rigv. i. 92, 14.
 II. f. वती.
 1. A cow.
 2. The last of the lunar asterisms.
 3. One of the मातृस् or energies of the gods.
 4. The wife of बल-राम,
रेवन्त् + अ, m. The fifth Manu of the present Kalpa or period.

रेवा (akin to रेवन्त्), f.
 1. The नर्मदा river,
